address: Shop 2111, 2F, Star Tower, Studio City, Estrada do Istmo, Cotai, Macau
bio: No expense was spared in fitting out this upscale restaurant, whose recurring dragon motif and stunning floral chandelier in the foyer are the epitome of lavish. The menu is equally elegant and rich in flavour: the squab two ways is a must – the crispy skin deep-fried bird showcases the precision of Cantonese cooking while the version steeped in Chaozhou spiced marinade oozes savoury depth. The tea counter boasts over 50 premium teas....
